objective: Sell and deliver the first four USD 250 collection-fit sprints to qualified customers with bounded private-knowledge needs, without implying an off-the-shelf hardware product.

source_evidence.current_order_mode: free fit check followed by a reviewed Stripe payment request
included_scope: a written data and privacy map
a small browser proof from a representative sample when usable
a go/no-go recommendation for a larger deployment
limits: Do not call the hardware ready to ship or imply that a standard kit is available.
Quote only the published USD 250 collection-fit sprint; do not invent a delivery date, support term, corpus entitlement, model benchmark, or hardware specification.
The public repository has no detected software license; describe it as public code, not open source, until the owner selects a license.
Ask about the collection, language goal, intended readers, rights, privacy needs, sample format, and existing hardware before requesting payment.
The generated product hero is a concept visual grounded in the current prototype and interface; never present it as shipped inventory.
A useful technical answer must stand on its own before mentioning the pilot page.

funnel.free_value: Inspect the public code, tests, architecture, and durable product brief.
funnel.qualified_interest: Request the free fit check with the collection, language goal, readers, sample format, rights, privacy needs, and existing hardware.
funnel.commercial_action: After a positive fit review, accept the fixed USD 250 sprint scope and complete a reviewed Stripe payment request.
funnel.gross_revenue_milestone: Four confirmed USD 250 payments equal USD 1,000 gross before fees, taxes, refunds, and delivery costs. Record revenue only after confirmed payment; page visits and inquiries are not sales.

reddit.policy: Reply only to a current private/local knowledge-base problem after checking community rules. Solve the technical question first and disclose affiliation if the pilot page materially helps.

x.policy: A future first-party product post may show the real word-card or word-origin interface and ask for one bounded pilot use case. It must remain unscheduled until exact review.

instagram.policy: Prefer the real current interface image. A generated prototype visual may be used only when the caption identifies it as a concept grounded in the current prototype; never present it as inventory.

hackernews.policy: Hacker News prohibits generated or AI-edited comments. Discover needs only; do not create or send agent-authored replies.
